about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm Fabio Andrés, a frontend developer focused on building user-centered digital experiences.

My journey into programming began at the age of 16 and followed an unconventional path through technical support and YouTube content creation. Those experiences broadened my perspective and strengthened my ability to understand real-world problems and communicate ideas effectively.
Today, I apply that experience to building intuitive and reliable software, writing clean, efficient code focused on solving real user needs.
